Charming All-Brick Cape Cod, Impeccably Updated with Prime Cheektowaga Location
Welcome home to this beautifully updated all-brick Cape Cod, where timeless architecture meets thoughtful modern refinement. A striking all-brick façade sets the tone from the moment you arrive, offering both curb appeal and enduring craftsmanship. Step inside to a light-filled family room, where gleaming hardwood floors and abundant natural light create an inviting, elevated first impression. The adjoining eat-in kitchen is a true showpiece — appointed with rich artisan cabinetry and under-mount lighting, polished granite countertops, a designer tile backsplash, recessed lighting, and premium stainless steel appliances. Throughout the home, exquisite millwork — including custom trim and crown molding — lends a refined, curated sensibility rarely found at this level. The thoughtful floor plan offers two generously sized bedrooms and a beautifully updated full bath on the main level, ideal for comfortable one-floor living. Central Air throughout both levels! Ascend to the second floor to discover an expansive primary suite, complete with a spa-inspired ensuite bath featuring a stunning oversized walk-in shower built for two with custom tile detailing, alongside an impressive walk-in closet. The partially finished lower level offers exceptional additional living space, perfect for entertaining or relaxed everyday enjoyment. This is truly a home where every detail has been considered — recent updates include paint, windows, electrical, HWT, drain tile, sump pump/back up, and roof, offering peace of mind for years to come. A two-car garage and private, tree-lined rear yard with no rear neighbors complete this exceptional offering.
